chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar narrated to us, saying: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated to us, from Ali ibn Asbat, from Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer, who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

about the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: 'O you who have believed, be patient, persevere and endure.' He said: Be patient for calamities, persevere due to Taqiya, remain stationed with the one you are following, and fear Allah that you might be successful.

key_terms.التقية: Taqiya (prudent dissimulation or endurance of concealment)

ai.seo_question: What is the specific meaning of patience, perseverance, and stationing in Surah Al Imran verse 200 according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) provides a nuanced exegesis of Quran 3:200, distinguishing between passive endurance of trials (*isbār*), active perseverance in the practice of *Taqiyya* (*ṣābira*), and spiritual vigilance by adhering to the Imam (*ribāṭ*). This interpretation highlights the strategic dimension of patience in Shia theology, linking personal resilience directly to political and religious survival under oppression. The emphasis on following the Imam underscores the centrality of *Imamah* as the anchor for maintaining faith during times of hardship.
